label: Project need
description: Document the community development need the project addresses, consistent with the ICDBG national objectives.

scoring.desc: Need is asserted without tribal community data.
Need is described but not linked to a specific national objective.
Need is data-supported and clearly linked to a national objective and tribal priorities.

common_failures: Mismatch between need and national objective

label: Benefit to low- and moderate-income persons
description: Quantify how the project benefits low- and moderate-income tribal members at or above the required threshold.

scoring.desc: Beneficiary counts do not meet the low-mod threshold or documentation is absent.
Beneficiary counts meet the threshold but methodology is thin.
Beneficiary counts exceed the threshold with a documented methodology and income data.

common_failures: Service area does not match beneficiary count
Area benefit claimed without supporting data

label: Project feasibility
description: Show the project can be completed on the proposed schedule with a realistic budget, environmental review, and procurement plan.

scoring.desc: Schedule, environmental review, or procurement plan is missing.
Plan is plausible but environmental review or procurement approach has gaps.
Schedule is realistic, environmental review path is identified, and procurement is aligned with 2 CFR Part 200.

common_failures: No NEPA or tribal environmental path identified
Procurement not aligned with 2 CFR Part 200

label: Management capacity
description: Demonstrate the tribe or TDHE has staff, policies, and federal award history to manage an ICDBG award.

scoring.desc: Applicant has no prior federal award or has unresolved findings.
Applicant has prior experience but policies or staff are not fully in place.
Applicant has prior ICDBG or comparable federal experience, clean audits, and named grant management staff.
